what do you think of my response to someone that is in the fringe (i think it;s a girl who was very guyish looking and talking about being bullied about bathroom, maybe mistakn for a guy.  Margins aren't calculated, they arise when the frame is built and the field is full.  There will always be marginal data, people and places. That cant be changed unless the field is forgotten. (when we stop counting who is what).  The margins, the fringes are where all amazing change starts, like the edges of a fractal and fills into the center. It’s a symbiotic relationship. And one the drives change/fear in the center;  It’s an important part to play but a lonely one too.



When we reach a place of safety we fear even more, well that is, were more on edge. The real dangers fade and we worry about *maybe*.  If left alone no big deal it fades but used as a Wedge Issue and boom. And worse than real fear which will pass (one either made it or not), this is like a rollercoaster ride that keeps climbing but never drops. Call it ‘Fear Edging’, keeping people on the edge of fear as long as possible so they either run away from it or are being pushed to attack it. Hence the duality, one can be under attack as an edge case and point at the attackers to get knuckled up rightfully so or one can pretend to be under attack and point at those who they want to attack. (a trick that is working well). But both can only come about in true stability (if bombs were dropping here for example, priorities would naturally re-sort).



How do you fix this? Simple, dissolve the frame, give up the field.  Recognize the dangers, put protections into place during dissolving and turn 90 degrees to mirror.  Stop observing the wave and it will stop existing.  (hint to the left; you cant fix irrational fears by yelling at someone they are wrong, you accept their fear is real, support it and dissolve it. replace it with trust not judgement or your just the right )



Your life or anyone's living in the edge wont get better from a spotlight on it (trust me i spent many years in music industry, the spot light is a toxic aging machine). Your life will get better when everyone stops giving a fck. when the field is gone and your just another anonymous face, just like everyone else.  Yes, as the edge you carry inevitable change, like a seed into the center of an all too stale system; but like a play action pass, We (those who live by truth) don't need to run around pointing it out like we do now. We run a screen, offer protection only when necessary and otherwise stfu and let the magic happen. It’s not fair i know, but your here to make it fair even if you do nothing more than be you which is all you can/need/expected to do. BUT YOU MUST use the failures to your advantage, that is the gift given when sht sucks, a way go navigate it.  If you don't then your just complaining and being dead right (“that truck should have stopped, i had green light” Yea, it should have but it didn't). Do the extra work and will be rewarded. (change costs, someone pays that tab). Looking for meaning in existence, well, it’s not always a bed of roses.



No Field, No Center, No Fringe.  Good luck, hold your frame longer and you will find that field will fall without you doing a single thing. Truth hides under lies but its the default layer. Hold your frame and the lies fade, they cant compare.  Learn to be anonymous, it’s what your dreaming of really, isn't it? — Be well my friend.
